claim_levels.controlled: Framework-independent controlled mechanism experiment on common LLM shapes.
claim_levels.native_problem: A paired experiment inside the named framework reproduces the problem mechanism.
claim_levels.native_solution: A paired framework-native counterfactual shows the proposed decision improves performance.
claim_levels.source: Pinned source proves the decision/control exists, but is not performance evidence.
